aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource writes to aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, but BCM Data Exports validates that the destination bucket policy grants access to bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com at export-creation time. The bucket policy (aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy) must exist before the export is created; no attribute reference or depends_on currently expresses this ordering, so a first apply can fail with Access Denied.

The bucket policy (aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy) must exist before the export is created; no attribute reference or depends_on currently expresses this ordering, so a first apply can fail with Access Denied.
